expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full component with DocumentFilter type, Selection discriminated union, all handlers, table with pagination, and bulk mutation calls

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Implemented functions: toggleDocument(), toggleCurrentPage(), selectAllMatching(), runBulkAction(), TableCheckbox component with full state wiring

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete uses native browser confirm: "if (action === 'delete' && !window.confirm(`Permanently delete...`)) { return; }" with no trash/recovery mechanism

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: "{selectedCount.toLocaleString()} document{selectedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected" shown in bulk action bar above action buttons

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Distinct UI states shown: "Select all {page.total.toLocaleString()} matching documents" button and "All matching documents are selected. Unchecking a row excludes it." message

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive styled 'bg-indigo-600' (primary blue), Delete styled 'bg-red-600' (red); both clearly distinct in color and appearance

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button appears first in button sequence with indigo (primary) styling; Delete follows with red (warning) styling

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Comment states: "The server must evaluate matching-filter selections server-side. This avoids sending thousands of document IDs when the user selects every matching result."

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Code ends with component closing; no closing prose or documentation naming prevented misuses
